annotation.title_clean: 关于推进互助性养老服务发展的意见
annotation.title_en: Opinions on Advancing the Development of Mutual-Aid Elderly Care Services
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 民政部、国家发展改革委、工业和信息化部等 (Ministry of Civil Affairs and other ministries; National Working Commission on Ageing)
annotation.venue: Ministry of Civil Affairs of China
annotation.summary_en: Chinese multi-ministry opinion (Min Fa [2026] No. 11) promoting neighbour- and community-based mutual-aid elderly care. It sets 2030 and 2035 targets, service models, facilities, funding and organisational responsibilities. AI and IoT are mentioned only in passing for informatisation; no robotics governance.
key_provisions_or_claims: By 2030, at least 70% of urban and rural community elder-care facilities should have mutual-aid functions.
Promotes community-supported home mutual aid, rural mutual-aid communities and time-bank (points) systems.
Encourages funding from government, collectives, families and donations, plus accident insurance for participants.
Supports use of internet, IoT and AI to raise informatisation of services.
Assigns duties to ministries and calls for developing standards for mutual-aid elder care.
